        "The full owned diff changes only signature-icon visibility: a nonempty signedState is shown when encryptedState is truthy, or the signature state is outside notok/mismatch/unknown. This preserves unverified and other accepted states without encryption, and keeps warnings for any truthy encryption state, not just successful decryption. The existing cryptoBox/technology-label gate is unchanged.",
        "The exact accepted function keeps the same condition, maps local notok display text to mismatch, and removes src, alt and localization data when hiding the signature icon. Existing focused icon-policy knowledge is reused. This UI choice does not change signature verification or make an encrypted message secure.",
        "The accepted S/MIME callbacks save their respective global status and then refresh from both saved states after their guards accept an update. OpenPGP likewise saves each nonempty string and calls the shared UI function with both retained values. This supports recomputing the combined display; it is not an unconditional event-order or completion guarantee. Later signature-count completion machinery is a separate phase.",
        "The original OpenPGP caller separately emits secureMsgLoaded with the unmodified signed/encrypted values for telemetry after the UI update. The rejected early proposal to alter the status producer is not in this final owned diff. The accepted comparison no longer has that historical event block, so no current telemetry contract is inferred from it.",
        "The three changed test files replace visible unknown/mismatch icon predicates with the actual hidden-icon helper. The helper directly checks the hidden attribute. However, in testOpenForwardedSigned the owned change also switches the attachment block from aboutMessage2 to aboutMessage: it checks the parent document instead of the opened attachment. Exact accepted source retains that receiver, so this is a direct assertion coverage gap.",
        "All changed assertion messages are non-empty and contain should. They do not establish fresh crypto or UI execution. Unrelated body-text and encryption predicates remain as written; the later wording-only patch is separate.",
        "The full primary Bug 1836262 current human timeline 0–11 and own D276028 creation-to-final timeline with all ten actual inline bodies, including two old-diff bodies rendered in the timeline, were read. The primary narrows the proposal to unencrypted bad/unknown signatures while retaining technology labels and detail access. A hard error page is disputed; a missing-signature warning for encrypted mail is a proposed separate follow-up, not adopted by this change.",
        "The reviewer rejects changing the OpenPGP status producer because secureMsgLoaded uses its values for telemetry. The author agrees. Exact final owned source changes the common rendering condition instead; the separately retained original caller emits the unchanged values. Current saved-state rendering remains, while the historical telemetry block is not assumed current.",
        "The reviewer repeatedly questions signature-before-encryption arrival order. The author explains that both saved values reach each refresh. Exact original S/MIME refresh/callback code and the accepted guarded callbacks support that bounded recomputation path; no unconditional callback delivery, processing completion or race test is claimed.",
        "The reviewer prefers should wording so diagnostics read as expected results on either pass or fail, and explicitly calls naming the exact status optional. The author changes touched assertions and separates wider consistency work into D276488. This historical request does not edit the deliberate user rules. Source inspection also retains the attachment-document receiver gap rather than treating approval as full coverage."
